mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the sound-sensitive membranes was most worthwhile: the result explained how movement in the cochlea bends hair bundles and changes nerve signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the outer and middle ear to the cochleas was clear but added little beyond the expected connection.

surprise.text: The explanation that bending hair-cell bundles changes signals to nerve fibers made the conversion from vibration to a nerve signal clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though several were predictable and the menu offered only one combination at a time after the second step.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it offered more meaningful choices or similarly clear explanations. This chapter's pathway was understandable, but most decisions became automatic.
